question: What is the meaning of purchase of renewable energy in the form of renewable energy credits (recs) in relation to renewable energy?
data_point: purchase of renewable energy in the form of renewable energy credits (recs)
description: Purchase of renewable energy in the form of renewable energy credits (RECs) is a way to support renewable energy projects by buying credits that represent the environmental benefits of renewable energy generation. This practice allows organizations to claim the use of renewable energy without necessarily having to generate it themselves, promoting the growth of renewable energy sources.
